blocks.title: Addition polymerisation
blocks.text: Addition polymerisation mein monomers aik aik kar ke aapas mein jur kar lambi zanjeerein banate hain. Monomers ke tamam atoms polymer ka hissa ban jate hain; kuch zaya nahi hota aur paani jaisa koi zimni product nahi banta.

Monomers mein C=C (ya C triple bond C) bond hona chahiye, jo khul kar monomers ko jurne deta hai. Yeh amal aksar chain reaction hota hai jo aik bohat reactive molecule, initiator, shuru karta hai jo free radicals banata hai. Maslan bohat se ethene molecules sira ba sira jurte hain: n CH2=CH2 -> [-CH2-CH2-]n (initiator, garmi, pressure), jahan n bohat bara, taqreeban 10 000 tak, hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: n CH2=CH2 initiator, garmi aur pressure se poly(ethene) deta, bracket mein -CH2-CH2- unit aur subscript n. Neeche: n CH2=CHCl se PVC zanjeer ka hissa, chhe carbons jin mein har doosre carbon par Cl; repeat unit -CH2-CHCl-.
blocks.caption: Ethene aur chloroethene ki addition polymerisation (kitab ke mua'adlon ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har soorat mein monomer ka double bond zanjeer mein single bond ban jata aur monomers sira ba sira jurte hain. Polymer ka empirical formula monomer jaisa hi hai, kyunke koi atom zaya nahi hota.

blocks.text: Poly(ethene) ki zyada tar do qismein hain. Low density poly(ethene) (LDPE) wahan use hota hai jahan bohat halka, naram maadda chahiye, jaise shopping bags aur halki plastic botlein. High density poly(ethene) (HDPE) ethene se kam pressure aur darja hararat par Ziegler-Natta catalyst ke saath banta aur plastic ke bartanon, mote shopping bags aur khilonon mein use hota hai. LDPE ki zanjeerein zyada shaakh dar hain, is liye qareeb nahi jamtin aur maadda kam thos aur zyada lachakdar hota hai; HDPE ki zanjeerein seedhi aur qareeb jamti hain, jis se sakht, ghani banawat banti hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: LDPE, shaakhon wali zigzag zanjeerein, dheeli jami hui. Daen: HDPE, seedhi zigzag zanjeerein qareeb qareeb.
blocks.caption: Shaakh dar LDPE aur seedhi HDPE zanjeerein (is topic ke liye asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Shaakhein LDPE ki zanjeeron ko door rakhti hain, is liye un ke darmiyan quwwatein kamzor aur plastic naram aur kam kasafat wala hai. Baghair shaakh HDPE zanjeerein pehlu ba pehlu leti hain, is liye quwwatein mazboot aur plastic zyada ghana aur sakht hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Ziegler-Natta catalysts Nobel inaam yafta ijaad hain jis ne plastic ki paidawar badal di. Karl Ziegler ne 1953 mein inhein daryaft kiya; in se ethene ki kam pressure par seedhi HDPE mein polymerisation mumkin hui, aur Giulio Natta ne inhein stereoregular polymers, jaise qalmi polypropene, tak barhaya.

PVC chloroethene se addition polymerisation se banta hai: n CH2=CHCl -> [-CH2-CHCl-]n. Is ki khasiyatein plasticisers mila kar kaafi badli ja sakti hain, jo polymer zanjeeron ke darmiyan mazboot quwwatein kam kar ke maadde ko naram, lachakdar aur aasani se kaam ke qabil banate hain. Sakht PVC (plasticisers ke baghair) sakht aur akra hua, zyada tar tezaabon, bases aur teilon ke khilaf kimiyai taur par be-asar, achha bijli insulator, chlorine atoms ki wajah se qudrati taur par jalne se mehfooz (khud bujhne wala), aur der pa hai. Plasticised PVC lachakdar aur naram hai aur aasani se moda aur dhala ja sakta hai, achhi kimiyai aur bijli khasiyatein barqarar rakhte hue.

items: Paani, nikasi aur sewage ke pipes aur fittings, kyunke yeh zang nahi khata aur der pa hai.
Khirki ke frame, darwaze ke profiles aur vinyl farsh ki tiles aur chadarein.
Taaron aur cables ki bijli insulation.
Tubing, khoon ke bags aur catheters.
Cling film, botlein (maslan khane ke tel ki) aur blister packs.
Barsatiyan, masnoo chamra aur hawa bhare products jaise swimming pools.

blocks.prompt: Plasticiser milane se PVC lachakdar kyun hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Plasticiser molecules polymer zanjeeron ke darmiyan aa kar un ke darmiyan mazboot quwwatein kam karte hain, is liye zanjeerein aazadi se aik doosre ke paas se sarak sakti hain.

items: Addition: C=C wale monomers jurte; kuch zaya nahi; initiator chain reaction shuru karta.
LDPE shaakh dar aur naram; HDPE seedha aur sakht (Ziegler-Natta).
PVC: sakht ya plasticised; pipes, insulation, tibbi tubing.
